value.name: Goldflame Qucusaur Tyrant
value.desc:
A Qucusaurus whose body has attained a supernatural form due to enduring forces that the bodies of modern Saurians cannot control.
Legends say that when the giant Qucusaur who now often dwells in the mountain fog was young, he also once followed the heroes who saved Natlan in their adventures. It is said that one of those heroes once agreed to make the pilgrimage with him together to the volcano, to save his mind back from the brink of insanity that the increasing violent power in his blood was forcing him towards. However, judging from his current title of "Tyrant," that story did not have a happy ending.

desc.text:
<color=#ffd780>Elemental Skill</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Deals 1</color> <color=#ff9999>Pyro DMG</color> <color=#ffffffa6>, and attaches 2 stacks of</color> <color=#ffffff>Flying Swirl</color> <color=#ffffffa6>to self.</color>
<color=#ece5d8>Flying Swirl</color>
<color=#ffd780>Status</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Next time you take damage: -1 DMG.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Usage(s): 1</color> <color=#ffffffa6>(Can stack. No stack limit)</color>

<color=#ffd780>Elemental Burst</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Deals 3</color> <color=#ff9999>Pyro DMG</color> <color=#ffffffa6>, and deals 1</color> <color=#ffffff>Piercing DMG</color> <color=#ffffffa6>to all opponent's off-field characters. Attaches 1 stack of</color> <color=#ffffff>Goldflame State</color> <color=#ffffffa6>to self.</color>
<color=#ece5d8>Goldflame State</color>
<color=#ffd780>Status</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>End Phase: If the character to which this is attached is your active character, deal 1</color> <color=#ff9999>Pyro DMG</color> <color=#ffffffa6>, and deal 1</color> <color=#ffffff>Piercing DMG</color> <color=#ffffffa6>to all opposing characters on standby.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Usage(s): 1</color> <color=#ffffffa6>(Can stack, no stack limit)</color>

<color=#ffd780>Passive Skill</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>(Passive)</color> <color=#ffffff>At the start of even-numbered Action Phases,</color> <color=#ffffffa6>attach 1 stack of</color> <color=#ffffff>Goldflame State</color> <color=#ffffffa6>to self.</color>

Applies Pyro and can trigger the following Elemental Reactions:
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#ff9999>Pyro</color> + <color=#99ffff>Cryo</color> <color=#ffffff>]</color> <color=#ffffff>Melt</color> : DMG +2 for this instance
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#ff9999>Pyro</color> + <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> <color=#ffffff>]</color> <color=#ffffff>Vaporize</color> : DMG +2 for this instance
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#ff9999>Pyro</color> + <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> <color=#ffffff>]</color> <color=#ffffff>Overloaded</color> : DMG +2 for this instance, the target is forcibly switched to the next character
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#ff9999>Pyro</color> + <color=#99ff88>Dendro</color> <color=#ffffff>]</color> <color=#ffffff>Burning</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, creates a [ <color=#ffffff>Burning Flame</color> ] that will deal 1 Pyro DMG at the end of the Round (Takes effect once, max 2 stacks)

<color=#ece5d8>Physical DMG</color>
Physical DMG will not apply any Elements, nor can it engage in Elemental Reactions.
<color=#ece5d8>Usage(s)</color>
After this card's effect is triggered, 1 <color=#ffffff>Usage</color> of it will be consumed.
This card will be discarded immediately once it has 0 <color=#ffffff>Usages</color> remaining.
<color=#ece5d8>Piercing DMG</color>
Piercing DMG cannot be increased by any bounses, but cannot be defended against using Shields or DMG Immunity either.
